prompt:
FANTASY MASTER REFERENCE FIRST: @Video1 is the master reference for the style, mood and characters of this whole clip. Match its render look, materials, colour palette, lighting mood, atmosphere, character design, proportions and animation feel on every frame; do not copy its exact shots, camera or story.

[Generation Goal] 20 seconds, 5 shots with hard cuts, 16:9, real-time 24 fps, no slow motion. The happy ending, told with discreet camera angles: NO face close-ups and never more than a few recognisable people in one frame. In the colossal dark BOSS arena (no villains), Mom kneels hugging Mai, Dad beside them, the puppy at Mai's feet, and their 8 friends standing in a loose arc around them. A ring of warm golden-pink light spreads from the family and transforms the arena into a joyful, dreamy PINK fantasy paradise; the camera rises to a soft pink sky and holds on an open, clean sky (a title will be added in post-production).

[Arena Scale] The BOSS arena is COLOSSAL: a vast open plaza hundreds of metres across, enclosed by skyscraper-tall cliffs of stacked monitors that recede for hundreds of metres into cyan-teal fog, an open dark sky above (no ceiling). @Image1 shows only ONE view of this huge space: keep its materials, but the space always continues far beyond it. People are small against the walls. Never a small room, corridor or low ceiling.

[References] @Video1: style, mood and world only (not camera, not costumes). @Image1: one high view of the BOSS arena, ONLY for materials and design (monitor-tower walls, dark wet floor, cables), not for camera angle or scale. Each following image is ONE separate person or object; copy each design exactly and keep every detail with its owner:
@Image2 = MAI ONLY: girl about 11, slim, fair skin, chin-length straight black BOB with full bangs, a small yellow hair clip on her left side; white short-sleeve school shirt with a navy sailor-style collar and navy sleeve cuffs, a red neckerchief tied at the collar; navy pleated knee-length skirt; white socks, white sneakers; light sky-blue backpack with a small yellow star charm. Unique: bob with bangs + sky-blue backpack.
@Image3 = MOM ONLY (the mother character of THIS project, an original design, not based on any existing film or cartoon character): woman about 40, kind face, hair in a low bun under a WHITE open-face motorbike helmet; a pale-YELLOW checked cape tied at her neck; a green apron with one white daisy over a white T-shirt; black wide-leg trousers; brown loafers; holds an ordinary black kitchen pan with a pink handle (NOT in this clip: her hands are free). Unique: white helmet + yellow checked cape + green daisy apron.
@Image4 = DAD ONLY: man about 45, short dark hair with grey streaks, rectangular dark-framed glasses, gentle smile; white crew-neck T-shirt under a chest-armour vest made of horizontal GREEN BAMBOO slats tied with brown cord, matching bamboo wrist guards; a wristwatch; dark navy trousers; brown leather sandals; bare hands, no gloves, no weapon. Unique: green bamboo-slat armour vest + glasses.
@Image5 = PUPPY ONLY: one small fluffy BLACK-AND-TAN puppy (tan muzzle, tan eyebrow spots, tan chest and paws), floppy ears, curled tail, happy. Exactly one dog.
@Image6 = CLEANER ONLY: woman about 40, warm face, hair in a low bun, a straw CONICAL HAT (nón lá) with a thin purple chin strap; long-sleeve ORANGE work jacket and orange cargo trousers with lime-yellow reflective stripes on the chest, sleeves and legs; black work shoes; her bamboo broom held upright at her side. Unique: conical hat + orange hi-vis uniform.
@Image7 = POLICE OFFICER ONLY: young man about 25, serious handsome face, short black hair; a dark-green PEAKED CAP with a small plain round cap badge, a thin gold cord and a black visor; a light olive-green SHORT-sleeve uniform shirt with bright RED collar tabs and RED shoulder boards, two chest pockets, gold buttons; a black belt with a gold buckle; DARK olive, almost black, trousers; black shoes; no weapon; badges unreadable. Unique: peaked cap + red collar tabs and shoulder boards + very dark trousers.
@Image8 = THE BUS ONLY: one compact GREEN minibus with a lighter green stripe along the sides, rounded friendly front, one folding front door, a large windscreen, round headlights; no text or numbers anywhere.
The other six friends (the Teacher in a pink áo dài, the Doctor in a white coat, the Security Guard bare-headed in khaki, the Engineer in a yellow hard hat, the bus driver in a light-blue cap, the Soldier in green camouflage) appear ONLY as tiny, distant, back-lit figures in shots 4-5, never close to the camera, never with readable faces.

[Head Count] EXACTLY 11 people in the whole scene, never more, never fewer, plus exactly 1 puppy; nobody else exists in this clip: no background crowd, no extra people, no twins or look-alikes; each person appears ONCE per frame.
1. Mai (@Image2): bob haircut, sky-blue backpack.
2. Mom (@Image3): white helmet, yellow checked cape.
3. Dad (@Image4): green bamboo armour vest, glasses.
4. The Cleaner (@Image6): conical hat, orange uniform.
5. The Police Officer (@Image7): peaked cap, red collar tabs.
6. The Teacher (tiny distant figure only): pink áo dài.
7. The Doctor (tiny distant figure only): white coat.
8. The Security Guard (tiny distant figure only): bare head, khaki.
9. The Engineer (tiny distant figure only): yellow hard hat.
10. The bus driver (tiny distant figure only): light-blue cap.
11. The Soldier (tiny distant figure only): green camouflage, pith helmet.
Plus: 1 puppy (@Image5). 1 parked green bus (@Image8), only in shots 1-3.

[No Blending] Every character is a SEPARATE person who keeps ONLY the costume, colours, hair and props of their own reference image or description. Never mix or swap clothing, hats, helmets or props; never merge two characters. Only Mom (@Image3) wears the white helmet and yellow checked cape; only Dad (@Image4) wears the green bamboo-slat vest; only the Cleaner (@Image6) wears a conical hat; only the Police Officer (@Image7) wears a peaked cap.

[Space & Blocking] The family is at the centre of the huge floor: Mom (@Image3) kneeling, hugging Mai (@Image2); Dad (@Image4) standing at Mom's right with one hand on both their shoulders; the puppy (@Image5) sitting against Mai's feet. The 8 friends stand in a loose arc several metres behind and around the family, all facing the family. The Cleaner (@Image6) and the Police Officer (@Image7) stand at the near end of the arc, a few metres apart from each other. In shots 1-3 only, the green bus (@Image8) is parked far behind in the haze; it dissolves with the arena in shot 4 and never appears again. Positions never change. Do not mirror the scene.

[Action & Camera, time-ordered] One dominant camera move per shot; no face close-ups.
Shot 1 (0-4 s), the hug from behind, 3 people visible (Mom, Mai, Dad) + the puppy: MEDIUM-WIDE, low angle from BEHIND and slightly to the left of Dad (@Image4), his back and green bamboo vest soft in the foreground, 28-35 mm, ONE slow arc from left to right: past Dad's shoulder we see Mom (@Image3) kneeling, her back and yellow cape toward camera, hugging Mai (@Image2), whose face is buried in her mother's shoulder; Dad lowers his hand onto both their shoulders; the puppy (@Image5) sits against Mai's feet, wagging its tail; the gigantic monitor cliffs recede far into the cold blue-violet fog. Cut.
Shot 2 (4-5.5 s), insert, no faces, only hands and the puppy in frame: close insert at waist height, 50-65 mm, slight push-in: Mom's (@Image3) hand gently squeezes Mai's (@Image2) shoulder strap of the sky-blue backpack; below, the puppy (@Image5) nuzzles its head against Mai's white sneaker. Cut.
Shot 3 (5.5-8 s), seen by the friends, 5 people visible (the Cleaner and the Police Officer from behind in the foreground, the family of three in the middle ground) + the puppy: MEDIUM-WIDE, eye level, 35 mm, camera BEHIND the arc, looking between the backs of the Cleaner (@Image6, conical hat) on the left and the Police Officer (@Image7, peaked cap) on the right, both slightly out of focus; ONE slow push-in through the gap toward the family; in the middle ground Mai (@Image2) slowly lifts her head from Mom's shoulder and looks around, her face small and soft in the distance; the parked bus (@Image8) glows far behind in the haze. Cut.
Shot 4 (8-13 s), transformation, ground level, 3 people visible (the family, small, from behind) + the puppy; the friends stay out of frame or are tiny back-lit shapes far away: WIDE, camera low at floor level, 20-24 mm, ONE slow rise (pedestal up) from the floor: right in front of the lens the dark wet floor cracks and soft green grass with pink, white and peach flowers blooms toward the camera; beyond it the family stands small in the middle, seen from behind; a ring of warm golden-pink light spreads outward from them; wherever it passes, the monitor walls, the parked bus and every dark object dissolve into sparkling smoke that bursts into pink and white petals, glowing butterflies and tiny floating lights; the dark sky dome opens onto a glowing pastel-pink and peach sky; a breeze lifts Mom's yellow cape and Mai's red neckerchief; Mai gives one small happy hop and the puppy chases a petal. Cut.
Shot 5 (13-20 s), the pink paradise, 11 people visible only as tiny distant silhouettes, each exactly once + the puppy: ULTRA-WIDE extreme establishing shot, 14-18 mm, ONE slow crane up that ends tilted toward the sky, then the camera STOPS and holds perfectly still from 17 s to 20 s: a joyful, dreamy pastel-PINK fantasy paradise: rolling hills of soft green grass covered with pink, white and peach flowers, round trees in full pink blossom, a sparkling stream, glowing lanterns and dandelion lights rising slowly; the group is a tiny cluster in the lower third (the family in the middle, the 8 friends in a loose arc), no faces readable; NO bus and no vehicles anywhere; pink petals drift up; the soft pink-and-peach sky with fluffy pink-gold clouds fills the upper two-thirds, open and clean, with nothing written in it.

[Acting] Emotion is carried by bodies, hands and posture, not by faces: Mom holds Mai as if she will never let go; Mai melts into the hug, then lifts her head slowly; Dad's hand is steady and protective; the friends stand still and relaxed, a few lean toward each other. In shots 4-5 joy blooms: light steps, one small hop, the puppy bouncing; everyone reacts on their own timing, never in sync. Classic animation principles: anticipation before actions, follow-through on hair, capes and petals, real weight.

[Character Look] Skin tone exactly as in each character reference: fair, light, warm-ivory skin with a soft healthy blush on the cheeks. Coloured scene light (cyan, teal, gold) only tints the skin softly on the lit side and in the rim; it never darkens, greys or browns the overall skin tone. Faces stay bright and readable, with a gentle fill on the faces even in dark shots.
[Expression] Subtle, restrained, natural expressions at about a third to half of full intensity, like a premium feature film, not a cartoon or meme face: small changes in the brows, eyelids and the corners of the mouth carry the emotion; mouths mostly closed or only slightly parted, opening wider only for a single breath and closing again; eyes widen only slightly; no gurning, no exaggerated eyebrows, no wide-open screaming mouth, no bulging eyes, no rubbery stretching face.

[Lighting] Shots 1-3: cold blue-violet ambient light in the huge dark arena, far walls fading into haze, a soft warm fill and rim on the family. Shots 4-5: bright dreamy pastel palette of soft PINK, peach, cream and fresh green, golden-pink sunlight, sparkles, soft bloom, warm rim light; no cold tones left.

[Visual Style] Exactly the style of @Video1 (premium stylized 3D animated feature film, soft rounded volumes, matte materials, fine film grain, slight bloom), turning to a bright, joyful, dreamy pastel-pink fantasy palette in shots 4-5. Children 6-6.5 heads tall, adults 7-7.5, not chibi. 16:9, real-time 24 fps.

[Audio] Sound effects and ambience only: soft breathing and fabric in the hug, the puppy's gentle whimper, a vast airy room tone, a rising shimmer of golden light, petals and leaves rustling, grass growing softly, the sky dome opening with a soft airy sound, a warm breeze, cheerful birdsong, soft wind chimes, magical tinkles, soft laughter, the puppy's happy yips. NO music, NO score, NO song, NO singing, NO melody, no dialogue.

[Avoid] face close-ups, faces filling the frame, more than 5 recognisable people in one frame, crowded frames; slow motion, speed ramp, freeze frame, fast-forward; any text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or readable badges; the same person twice in one frame, twins, clones, extra people, background crowd, more than 11 people, more than one puppy; characters blending together, swapped costumes, a hat or helmet on the wrong person, merged characters; a pan in Mom's hands; dark, tanned, grey or muddy skin; over-acting, gurning, wide open mouths; hoodie, chibi; mirrored layout, crossing the action line; flat lighting, sterile plastic CG, pasted-on characters; sliding feet, morphing, extra fingers or limbs; robotic or floaty motion; small room, corridor, low ceiling, cramped space; the bus in shots 4-5, any moving vehicle, black smoke; gloomy, grey or cold colours in shots 4-5; purple or violet in the pink paradise; top-down framing in shots 1-3; any title, words or letters in the sky; villains, shadow figures or creatures; background music, score, singing; resemblance to any existing film, cartoon, game or comic character or brand; studio or film names.
